copy.curiosityHook: When an intercepted interstellar transmission teaches human scientists how to engineer an alien hybrid, can they survive the lethal organism they brought to life?
copy.description: After SETI scientists follow extraterrestrial instructions to splice alien genetic code with human DNA, they produce Sil, an alluring hybrid who swiftly morphs into an armour-plated killing machine.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, kinetic sci-fi horror balancing high-stakes thrills with an adventurous, engaged watch.
copy.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson fuses speculative bio-thriller curiosity with fast-escalating sci-fi horror, staging a lethal cat-and-mouse threat powered by terrifying rapid transformations.

allowedMaterial: Sil's character and dual nature as a beautiful woman and armored killing machine
